lemmas.primary_translation: to buy out another person’s share

definitions.text: kjøpe en annens andel av en eiendom, bedrift eller lignende
definitions.translation: buy another person’s share of a property, business, or the like

examples.no: han har kjøpt ut eksen, så nå eier han huset alene
examples.en: he has bought out his ex, so now he owns the house alone
